question: Which club won the 2019 FIFA Club World Cup?
solution:
The correct answer is **Liverpool.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **16th iteration** of the FIFA Club World Cup took place in 2019.
 
• A competition between the winners of the** six continental confederations **and the league champions of the host country, organised by FIFA.
 
• **Liverpool won the FIFA Club World Cup** for the first time after defeating** Flamengo 1-0 in a thrilling game in Doha, Qatar,** thanks to an extra-time goal from Roberto Firmino. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__​**

 
• Sumitomo, like all other clubs, reconstituted as the** Kashima Antlers **after the J.League's establishment and removed the corporate identity from its moniker.
 
• **Flamengo**, a Brazilian team and the current Copa Libertadores champions, represents CONMEBOL.
 
• With a 2-1 victory against opponents on the road,** Monterrey guaranteed** their entry into the World Club Cup.
